description: This Java interface defines the contract for handling custom values associated with OpenMRS entities, facilitating retrieval, setting, serialization, and validation of custom data values within the OpenMRS medical record system.

classes.name: SingleCustomValue
classes.description: An interface representing a custom data value within OpenMRS, capable of providing metadata, serialized references, typed values, and change state management.

methods.name: getDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the metadata descriptor for this custom value.

methods.name: getValueReference
methods.description: Retrieves the database string reference of the value, potentially throwing an exception if not yet persisted.

methods.name: setValueReferenceInternal
methods.description: Sets the internal string value for persistence, with validation and exception handling.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the typed value by converting the reference string using a CustomDatatype.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the typed value, converting it to a reference string internally.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Indicates whether the value has been modified since last persistence.
